l4Discriminating.text: Synthetic data generation artifact where an external generator applies an arbitrary 1.50 site multiplier — If measurements are generated by an external simulation or synthetic script rather than physical reality, a global site modifier of 1.50 may have been assigned to observatory parameters without accounting for dimensional reciprocity. The absence of exact run repetitions or low-precision quantization does not rule out continuous synthetic generation.
